name: Addition
description: Fifty-two ways to add, from counting two groups to choosing which strategy the numbers deserve.
author: Koda Math Lab
tagline: Put groups together, then learn the shortcuts.

features.name: Spoken voice
features.description: Reads the question aloud when it opens, counts along as a child taps, and speaks every hint. Turn off for a silent lesson.

features.name: Sound chimes
features.description: Pop and success chimes as objects are touched.

features.name: Haptic vibration
features.description: A vibration pulse on each tap and each completed group.

features.name: 1-to-1 badges
features.description: Numbers each touched object, so nothing is counted twice.

features.name: Running total
features.description: Shows the count so far beside the groups, as it grows.

features.name: Strategy scaffold
features.description: Says in words what the model is showing — what is in the frame, which box to fill next, what has been jumped. Turn off to have the child read the picture alone.

features.name: Step framing tags
features.description: Labels each step — warm-up, guided challenge, final milestone — beside the step counter.

features.name: Charge for later lessons
features.description: How many lessons stay free is “Free lessons” on the Settings tab; the rest need a plan that includes the full course.

settingsSchema.label: Warm-up tag
settingsSchema.help: Wording for step 1. Leave blank to use the default.

settingsSchema.label: Activity tag
settingsSchema.help: Wording for even-numbered steps. Leave blank to use the default.

settingsSchema.label: Guided tag
settingsSchema.help: Wording for odd-numbered steps. Leave blank to use the default.

settingsSchema.label: Final tag
settingsSchema.help: Wording for the last step. Leave blank to use the default.

settingsSchema.label: Speech rate
settingsSchema.help: How fast the counter and the hints are spoken.

settingsSchema.label: How answers are given
settingsSchema.help: A number pad to type on, or four numbers to choose between. Choosing suits a younger child; typing is what the written lessons need.

settingsSchema.label: Free lessons
settingsSchema.help: How many of this skill's lessons anyone can play. The rest need the plan. Only applies while 'Charge for later lessons' is on.
